messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: PROD auth-service - token validation error rate > 10% (5m) — P1 page fired. paging: @alyssa (primary), @mohit (secondary) :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Incident 67321 opened -> https://pagerduty.example/INC67321 - urgency: high

alyssa: acked (oncall). jumping in. seeing 502s and 'invalid_kid' in logs.

mohit: on my way. any customer-facing errors? sara-support, can you confirm reports?

sara-support: getting 3 tickets from enterprise customers in EU complaining about auth failures during login. CS says 401s in the UI. will open a postmortem queue.

alyssa: quick snapshot from auth-service logs:
```
2026-03-10T15:12:34Z WARN token_verify: invalid_kid kid=abc123 request_id=req-9a7f
2026-03-10T15:12:34Z ERROR jwks_fetch: mismatch between cached jwks and remote (kid not found)
2026-03-10T15:12:35Z INFO signer_fallback: attempted fallback signer -> unavailable
```

kevin: that 'invalid_kid' looks like JWKS rotation mismatch. charlie-infra, did keypush run in the last hour to prod?

charlie-infra: we did a rolling jwks publish ~15m ago from key-rotation job. logs show success to s3 and pubsub message delivered, but reconciler shows some nodes still using old cache. investigating cache invalidation path.

dana-ops: noticed increased 5xxs on auth-verify endpoint in LB metrics starting 15:10Z, consistent with key rotation window.

mohit: mitigation options: (1) force immediate JWKS cache purge across all auth instances, (2) revert to previous keyset on S3, (3) enable emergency hotfix that treats unknown kid as retry after fetching remote JWKS. Thoughts?

alyssa: priority is restore traffic; safest immediate action is purge caches + trigger sync. if that fails, rollback JWKS file.

charlie-infra: running cache flush job now: `kubectl exec -n authdeploy -c cache-sync auth-0 -- /app/bin/cachectl flush && /app/bin/cachectl reload-jwks` — running across nodes in parallel. posting progress.

incident-bot: cache-flush job started (job/flush-jwks-1754321987) — 0/24 pods completed.

10m later...

charlie-infra: 18/24 pods completed, 6 still retrying due to 429s from internal metadata service. throttling is weird. backoff in place.

mohit: while flush is in flight, enable a short-lived permissive fallback for signers? I can push a config toggle that allows a single remote JWKS refetch on invalid_kid before failing. low blast, but reduces customer impact. need approval.

alyssa: approve. make it rollbackable and limited to 10m ttl. capture metrics.

mohit: pushing config change to canary (auth-1). command below:
```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: auth-runtime-config
  namespace: auth
data:
  allow_remote_jwks_fetch_on_invalid_kid: "true"
  remote_fetch_ttl_seconds: "600"
EOF
```

incident-bot: Deploy started -> canary auth-1 (rev: config-1754321987-canary).

kevin: can we validate token flow now? curl test against canary: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <sample>" https://auth-canary.internal/v1/verify`

mohit: canary returns 200 for same sample token that failed earlier. logs show `remote_jwks_refetch -> succeeded` and token accepted.

alyssa: good signal. charlie, any ETA on flush finish?

charlie-infra: all pods now flushed. 24/24. reconciler shows all nodes loading new JWKS.

incident-bot: cache-flush job completed (job/flush-jwks-1754321987) — success.

dana-ops: production 5xx rate for auth-verify dropping back to baseline in the last 60s.

alyssa: rolling out the config change to prod with a staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) to avoid surprises. monitoring SLOs.

mohit: rollout at 10% -> no regressions after 2m. progressing to 50%.

sara-support: customer tickets are being updated: leaving interim note that we have identified JWKS rotation mismatch; engineers are mitigated and we expect full restoration within 10-15m.

mohit: 100% rollout complete. all nodes returning 200 on verification.

alyssa: switching incident state: mitigated. preparing post-incident checklist. key items: investigate why cache invalidation missed some nodes (429 throttling), tighten pubsub retries, add additional healthcheck on JWKS reload, and consider staggered key rotations with rolling grace period.

pagerduty: Incident 67321 -> status: acknowledged -> status changed to resolved by alyssa.

dana-ops: handing off to charlie for post-incident action items and long-term fixes. @charlie-infra you own follow-ups.

charlie-infra: got it — will open follow-up RFC and set up runbook improvements. I'll also add a job to verify JWKS reachability post-publish.

alyssa: thanks team. final notes: estimated customer impacted sessions ~ 1200 (peak 2.4% of auth traffic) across EU region, most errors between 15:10Z-15:20Z. saving logs and traces to incident folder: `s3://redwood-incidents/INC67321/`

sara-support: I'll reach out to affected accounts with a summary and timeline after postmortem draft.

incident-bot: Incident 67321 resolved — summary: temporary permissive remote JWKS refetch + cache purge restored verification. Follow-ups assigned to charlie-infra. :white_check_mark:
